name: get-issue
description: Gets a GitHub issue or pull request by number with up to 100 of its comments, its labels and assignees. The number comes from github__list-issues, github__list-pull-requests or github__search-issues-and-pull-requests, the owner and repository from github__list-my-repositories.

owner.description: The repository's owner, the part before the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

repo.description: The repository's name, the part after the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

issueNumber.description: The issue's or pull request's number; github__list-issues or github__search-issues-and-pull-requests answers it.
